finalText:
All 625 cases pass now, and `verify.js` confirms the fix.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount — contradicting its own docstring ("the discount has to come off the base before the rate is applied to it"). One-line fix: tax now uses `discounted * taxRate` instead of `cents * taxRate`.
